title: Port automation modules from complete-v4-hook
goal: Bring the lease-fenced AutomatedCycleService, budget gate, and fee-settlement observer onto the merged base, rewired to the escrow-based funding model, the new DEGRADED/dust-fast-path vault states, and the durable production cycle store.
steps: Port the 189-line AutomatedCycleService (lease + budget-gate + 8-stage driver, dependency-injected leaseStore/budgetReader/cycleRepository/runnerFactory/stageDriver/feeSettlementObserver) largely as-is
Rewire the funding stage to target the per-cycle PegCycleReturnEscrow instead of the vault directly
Add a new stage boundary at the Track-B join (design §2.4 step 9) that blocks on both the finalized return amount and the distribution-signer/verifier signatures before calling authorizePayout
Port CycleRunner.supersedeUnobservedIntent unchanged (dual independent observer proofs + fresh owner-signed authorization)
Carry forward the additive SwapLiabilitiesAccrued event integration
acceptance: All ported automation tests pass against the merged, revised contracts
No duplicate on-chain function signatures between ported code and WP-01/03/05's contracts
The new Track-B join stage blocks correctly until both preconditions are present in a fixture test
notes: This is the automation core; it must not reintroduce complete-v4-hook's conflicting HookemonHook.sol/ProcessBudget.sol changes. R3, touches money-moving stage transitions: per AGENTS.md, use a fresh-context independent reviewer before merge.
